preconditions.description: The input string contains at least one digit.
The length of the input string does not exceed 10^6 characters.
The input string consists of digits only.

postconditions.description: The output string is not empty.
The output string contains exactly one '+' character.
The output string contains exactly one '=' character.
The left part of the output string does not have a leading zero.
The middle part of the output string does not have a leading zero.
The right part of the output string does not have a leading zero.
The sum of the left and middle parts equals the right part.
